messages.content:
How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
Version: 6.3.1
IP: 192.120.45.67
API name: get information of an interface
Parameter_fabricName: Network1
Parameter_nodeId: 12
Parameter_podId: 10
Parameter_interfaceType: Ethernet
Parameter_infoType: Speed

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Send a GET request to retrieve specified information for an interface from a network telemetry API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to. This should include the base path without query parameters, e.g., 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'.

params.description: The query parameters for the request.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit nodes pertaining to.

nodeId.description: The node identifier to limit results pertaining to.

podId.description: The pod identifier to limit results pertaining to.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit results pertaining to.

infoType.description: The type of information requested for the interface.

Wait, the example says: 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'. But the API name is "get information of an interface". That might correspond to that endpoint. So we need to call the function with url: 'https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo' and params: {fabricName: 'Network1', nodeId: 12, podId: 10, interfaceType: 'Ethernet', infoType: 'Speed'}.

But note that interfaceType options are "gigabitethernet", "fastethernet", "ethernet", "serial". The user gave "Ethernet" capitalized. Should we convert to lowercase? The param type is "ethernet". So we should use "ethernet". Also infoType options are "statistics", "status", "config", "Speed". The last one is "Speed" capitalized. Should we keep as "Speed"? The type says "Speed" with capital S. So we can use "Speed".

Thus we call the function. Then we need to output the request. The user asked: "How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?" They want the request. So we should show the GET request with query parameters appended or as JSON body? Usually GET uses query parameters. So we can show the full URL with query string: https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed

We can also mention that we need to authenticate, maybe using Basic Auth or token. But not required.
